headline: US Dollar Rallies to Multi-Month Highs Across Major Currencies
summary: The US dollar advanced sharply across global FX markets, recording its strongest performance since recent tariff policy announcements.
why: The US dollar is the world's primary reserve currency and benchmark for international financial trades.

impacts.name: US Dollar Index
impacts.why: High interest rate expectations and strong capital inflows bolstered the greenback.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of sustained higher interest rates in the US fueled dollar buying against major pairs.
